name: Eli Savit
summary: Eli Noam Savit is an American lawyer, professor, and politician serving as the prosecuting attorney of Washtenaw County, Michigan, since 2021. A member of the Democratic Party, Savit is the attorney general-elect following the 2026 election. He previously served as senior legal counsel in the office of Detroit Mayor Mike Duggan, and as a law clerk to Supreme Court Justices Sandra Day O'Connor and Ruth Bader Ginsburg.
